'''Written Shimiese''' was the written form of the [[Shimiese/Legends|Shimiese]] [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]]. It was a pictographic script, and its symbols could represent nouns, verbs, and figures of speech.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
